name: language-model-chat-provider
description: Registers an OpenAI-compatible LanguageModelChatProvider (Kilo Gateway / OpenRouter) with VS Code's language model API.

languageModelChatProvider.baseUrl.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API. Use https://api.kilo.ai/api/gateway for the Kilo Gateway or https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 for OpenRouter.

languageModelChatProvider.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key for the chat completions API (e.g. a `KILO_API_KEY` or `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`).

languageModelChatProvider.model.description: Model ID sent to the chat completions endpoint. Examples: kilo-auto/free, nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free, openrouter/free.

languageModelChatProvider.maxOutputToken.description: Maximum number of output tokens to request from the model.
